appearance_facts.fact: The title 'Prevalence of Species Z in US States' is printed in large, bold black text.
A vertical color bar runs from bottom to top, labeled 'Low' at the bottom (dark red) and 'High' at the top (light yellow).
The color bar has numerical tick marks at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100, with corresponding color segments.
States are colored according to prevalence, with darker red indicating lower prevalence and lighter yellow indicating higher prevalence.
Pennsylvania (PA) is colored dark red, indicating the lowest prevalence among the three options.
New Jersey (NJ) is colored light yellow, indicating the highest prevalence among the three options.
Delaware (DE) is colored light orange, indicating a medium prevalence.
The state of Pennsylvania (PA) is located in the northeastern United States, bordered by New Jersey (NJ) to the south and New York (NY) to the north.

public_definitions: The task is to use the state prevalence dashboard to select the state with the highest prevalence for routing into the highest-prevalence priority follow-up workflow.

The options are: Open New Jersey (NJ) prevalence detail for priority follow-up, Open Pennsylvania (PA) prevalence detail for priority follow-up, Open Delaware (DE) prevalence detail for routine monitoring.
The routing criterion is 'Highest prevalence state in the dashboard'.
The record workflow is 'State prevalence priority follow-up'.
The program area is 'Species Z prevalence surveillance'.
